description:
## Return YouTube Username v2.2.1

- Support CJK & Unicode Handles: Fixed handle regex to support Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and all international Unicode handles in comments and Shorts.
- URL-Encoding for Public Resolver: Ensure CJK handles are properly URL-encoded during network resolution.
- Exclude Channel Profile Headers: Prevent channel page profile headers and bottom sheets from replacing the channel's @handle under the channel name with the channel title.
- Pure Standalone Morphe Patch Bundle: Only contains Return YouTube Username without duplicating official patches.
- Zero conflict: seamlessly loads and patches alongside official Morphe patches on Morphe Manager (Android) and Morphe CLI.
- Independent Settings Menu: Dedicated 'Return YouTube Username' screen in Morphe settings.
- Fully compatible with Morphe 2.1.0+ and YouTube 21.30.216.
